step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Visual Analysis: The diagram shows a GATEWAY component on the far left with three outbound arrows leading to three parallel processing paths:
   - Top path: SQS queue -> INGEST Lambda function -> RDS database.
   - Middle path: SQS queue -> EVENT PROC Lambda function -> RDS database.
   - Bottom path: S3 bucket -> IMAGE PROC Lambda function -> RDS database.

2. Service Identification:
   - GATEWAY -> ApiGateway
   - SQS (top & middle) -> SQS
   - S3 -> S3
   - INGEST, EVENT PROC, IMAGE PROC -> Lambda
   - RDS -> RDS

3. Edge Construction & Logical Sequencing:
   - Flow 0 (Ingestion): GATEWAY (0) -> SQS (1) -> INGEST Lambda (2) -> RDS (7)
   - Flow 1 (Event Processing): GATEWAY (0) -> SQS (3) -> EVENT PROC Lambda (4) -> RDS (7)
   - Flow 2 (Image Processing): GATEWAY (0) -> S3 (5) -> IMAGE PROC Lambda (6) -> RDS (7)

graph.name: Purolator Package Ingestion and Event Processing Architecture
graph.notes: Serverless package tracking and image processing pipeline built on AWS Lambda, SQS, S3, and RDS.

nodes.name: GATEWAY
nodes.notes: Ingress gateway for incoming package data and events

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Queue for initial package creation messages

nodes.name: INGEST
nodes.notes: Lambda function for ingesting package metadata

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Queue for package status and event scans

nodes.name: EVENT PROC
nodes.notes: Lambda function for processing various package events

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: S3 bucket for storing dimensioning/weighing package images

nodes.name: IMAGE PROC
nodes.notes: Lambda function for processing images and generating image links

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Central relational database serving as the single source of truth

edges.notes: Package creation intent routed to top SQS queue
Ingest Lambda consumes message from top SQS queue
Ingest Lambda writes initial package record to RDS
Package scan events routed to middle SQS queue
Event Proc Lambda consumes event message from middle SQS queue
Event Proc Lambda updates event data in RDS
Package image uploaded to S3 bucket
S3 event triggers Image Proc Lambda
Image Proc Lambda stores image link and metadata in RDS
